Wall/cycle associations do not identify scheduling, frequency, migration, cache or DSP causes; cycles are not elapsed time. Equal outputs do not prove equal computation cost. Finite snapshots/quiet audits prove neither continuous quiet nor priority, and foreign allocations are outside the Rust counter.

Paced-null has no processor endpoints. Frontend Python/browser activity observed about two minutes after measurement is not evidence of interference during it and justifies no exclusion or attribution.

Endpoint diagnostic: the first across-pair predecessor is unknown only for that table's denominator; no kernels were dropped. Endpoint changes are neither necessary nor sufficient for excesses. The endpoint window includes counter reads outside the timer; equal endpoints cannot exclude migration away/back, differing ones do not localize it, and observation may perturb execution.

Fixed CPU applies only to the benchmark thread and does not reserve a CPU. Normal restoration/endpoints were verified; error/unwind restoration was source-reviewed only. Eight late pair completions remain distinct from zero per-kernel 10ms misses.

Synthetic pair releases do not prove live CPAL/queue/device service. Saved verifiers did not execute native code or rerender audio. Exact original scope/no-further-work statements remain in retained detail and are not current authorizations.
